name: hugging-face
label: Hugging Face
description: Run inference on 100,000+ open ML models for NLP, vision, and audio tasks

token.label: API Token
token.description: Your Hugging Face API token (get it from https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens)

get_model.label: Get Model
get_model.description: Get the Hub metadata of one model repository.

repo_id.label: Repository ID
repo_id.description: The repository ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'openai-community/gpt2' or 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Models, Search Datasets or Search Spaces.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit SHA, for example 'main' or 'refs/pr/1'. Leave empty for the default branch.

get_dataset.label: Get Dataset
get_dataset.description: Get the Hub metadata of one dataset repository.

repo_id.label: Repository ID
repo_id.description: The repository ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'openai-community/gpt2' or 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Models, Search Datasets or Search Spaces.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit SHA, for example 'main' or 'refs/pr/1'. Leave empty for the default branch.

get_space.label: Get Space
get_space.description: Get the Hub metadata of one Space.

repo_id.label: Repository ID
repo_id.description: The repository ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'openai-community/gpt2' or 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Models, Search Datasets or Search Spaces.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit SHA, for example 'main' or 'refs/pr/1'. Leave empty for the default branch.

get_user_overview.label: Get User Profile
get_user_overview.description: Get the public profile of a Hugging Face user.

username.label: Username
username.description: The user's Hub username, for example 'julien-c'.

get_organization_overview.label: Get Organization Profile
get_organization_overview.description: Get the public profile of a Hugging Face organization.

organization.label: Organization
organization.description: The organization's Hub name, for example 'huggingface' or 'meta-llama'.

get_paper.label: Get Paper
get_paper.description: Get the details of one research paper on Hugging Face.

paper_id.label: Paper ID
paper_id.description: The paper's arXiv ID, for example '2307.09288'.

include_comments.label: Include Comments
include_comments.description: Also return the comments on the paper page, with their comment IDs.

include_submission_deadline.label: Include Submission Deadline
include_submission_deadline.description: Also return the conference submission deadline linked to the paper, when there is one.

check_dataset_viewer_support.label: Check Dataset Viewer Support
check_dataset_viewer_support.description: Check which dataset viewer features (preview, rows, search, filter, statistics) a dataset supports.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

config.label: Subset (Config)
config.description: Optional subset (config) name, for example 'plain_text'. Leave empty to cover every subset. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

split.label: Split
split.description: Optional split name, for example 'train'. Only used together with a subset (config).

list_dataset_splits.label: List Dataset Subsets & Splits
list_dataset_splits.description: List the subsets (configs) and splits of a dataset in the dataset viewer.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

config.label: Subset (Config)
config.description: Optional subset (config) name, for example 'plain_text'. Leave empty to cover every subset. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

get_dataset_viewer_info.label: Get Dataset Schema & Info
get_dataset_viewer_info.description: Get the column schema (features), description, license, citation and split sizes of a dataset.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

config.label: Subset (Config)
config.description: Optional subset (config) name, for example 'plain_text'. Leave empty to cover every subset. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

get_dataset_size.label: Get Dataset Size
get_dataset_size.description: Get the number of rows and bytes of a dataset, per subset and per split.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

config.label: Subset (Config)
config.description: Optional subset (config) name, for example 'plain_text'. Leave empty to cover every subset. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

get_dataset_statistics.label: Get Column Statistics
get_dataset_statistics.description: Get per-column statistics (counts, nulls, min/max/mean, histograms, label frequencies) of a dataset split.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

config.label: Subset (Config)
config.description: The subset (config) name, for example 'plain_text' or 'default'. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

split.label: Split
split.description: The split name, for example 'train', 'test' or 'validation'. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

list_dataset_parquet_files.label: List Parquet Files
list_dataset_parquet_files.description: List the auto-converted Parquet files of a dataset, with their download URLs and sizes.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

config.label: Subset (Config)
config.description: Optional subset (config) name, for example 'plain_text'. Leave empty to cover every subset. List valid names with List Dataset Subsets & Splits.

get_dataset_leaderboard.label: Get Dataset Leaderboard
get_dataset_leaderboard.description: Get the models ranked by their evaluation score on a benchmark dataset.

dataset.label: Dataset ID
dataset.description: The dataset ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'stanfordnlp/imdb'. Find it with Search Datasets.

task_id.label: Task ID
task_id.description: Optional benchmark task for datasets with several tasks, for example 'gsm8k'. It matches the eval result file name (.eval_results/<task>.yaml). Leave empty for the default task.

max_params.label: Max Parameters
max_params.description: Only models up to this size, for example '10B', '500M' or a raw count such as '7000000000'.

base_model.label: Model Scope
base_model.description: Leave empty for the Hub default (base models only), or include fine-tuned and derived models as well.

upsert_space_secret.label: Set Space Secret
upsert_space_secret.description: Create or update a secret environment variable of a Hugging Face Space.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The Space ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'my-user/my-demo'.

key.label: Key
key.description: The secret name: starts with a letter, then letters, digits or underscores, for example 'OPENAI_API_KEY'.

value.label: Value
value.description: The secret value. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

description.label: Description
description.description: Optional note about what the secret is for.

delete_space_secret.label: Delete Space Secret
delete_space_secret.description: Delete a secret from a Hugging Face Space.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The Space ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'my-user/my-demo'.

key.label: Key
key.description: The name of the secret to delete, for example 'OPENAI_API_KEY'.

upsert_space_variable.label: Set Space Variable
upsert_space_variable.description: Create or update a public environment variable of a Hugging Face Space.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The Space ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'my-user/my-demo'.

key.label: Key
key.description: The variable name: starts with a letter, then letters, digits or underscores, for example 'MODEL_NAME'.

value.label: Value
value.description: The variable value. It is visible to anyone who can see the Space.

description.label: Description
description.description: Optional note about what the variable is for.

delete_space_variable.label: Delete Space Variable
delete_space_variable.description: Delete an environment variable from a Hugging Face Space.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The Space ID in 'namespace/name' form, for example 'my-user/my-demo'.

key.label: Key
key.description: The name of the variable to delete, for example 'MODEL_NAME'.
